name: Pro Draw
purpose: Show them a pass, let their linemen run upfield, then hand it up the middle. Best on an obvious passing down after we have actually thrown it a few times.

X.rule: Run a route straight downfield. Sell the pass.

LT.rule: Set like pass protection for one count, then drive your man wherever he wants to go.

LG.rule: Set like pass protection, then drive your man past the play.

C.rule: Set for one count, then block the nose and turn him. The hole is behind you.

RG.rule: Set like pass protection, then drive your man past the play.

RT.rule: Set like pass protection, then drive your man past the play.

TE.rule: Release like a route for two steps, then block the closest linebacker.

Z.rule: Run a route straight downfield. Sell the pass.

QB.rule: Drop three steps holding the ball high like you are throwing, then hand it to the halfback on his way past.

FB.rule: Step up and block anybody who comes free. Sell the protection.

HB.rule: Wait one full count with your hands ready like you are protecting, then take the handoff and run right up the middle.

coaching_points: The halfback waiting that extra count is the entire play. He will want to leave early — do not let him.
Only call this after we have actually thrown the ball. A draw off a run-only offense fools nobody.
